[Story]
At a friend's gathering, Li Ming learns that his friend Xiao Hong is going to Beijing. A week later, Li Ming unexpectedly meets Xiao Hong in Beijing, and he asks in surprise, "Xiao Hong, how come you're here?" Xiao Hong replies with a smile, "Didn't you ask me last week which city I was going to?"

[Question]
Why does Li Ming say this?

[Candidate Answers]
A. Li Ming knows the city Xiao Hong is going to, but he pretends to be surprised.
B. Li Ming forgets the city Xiao Hong is about to go to that he discusses with her last week.
C. Li Ming does not expect to meet Xiao Hong.
D. Xiao Hong does not tell Li Ming the city she is about to go to at the party.
